notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Atsushi.
You have gained life this turn.
description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Oathsworn Vampire enters the battlefield as a copy of Atsushi due to Infinite Reflection.
Choose to put Oathsworn Vampire into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Oathsworn Vampire dies, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
